title: Nomba Webhook Event
description: Schema for validating Nomba webhook event payloads delivered to merchant endpoints when subscribed events occur.

event_type.description: The type of event that triggered the webhook notification.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for this webhook delivery request, useful for deduplication.

data.description: The event payload containing merchant, terminal, and transaction details.

originalTransactionId.description: The transaction ID of the original payment or payout for reversal and refund events.

error.description: A description of why the payment or payout failed, present on failure events.

Merchant.description: Merchant account information associated with the event.

walletId.description: The unique identifier for the merchant wallet.

walletBalance.description: The current wallet balance after the event occurred.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the merchant user.

Terminal.description: POS terminal information, populated for terminal-based transactions.

terminalId.description: The unique identifier of the POS terminal.

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the POS terminal hardware.

transactionId.description: The unique identifier for the transaction.

type.description: The type of transaction, such as vact_transfer for virtual account transfers.

aliasAccountNumber.description: The alias account number associated with the transaction.

fee.description: The fee charged for the transaction.

sessionId.description: The session identifier for the transaction.

Order.description: Checkout order information, present on order_success events.

orderReference.description: The unique reference for the checkout order.
